title: The Substrate Before Inscription

features.name: the blank page that remembers being a tree
features.desc-on-touch: Paper in plantation rows, each sheet like a leaf. You trace the grain and find tree-rings, still counting. Nothing is written here, but everything is ready to be.

features.name: the fence line of words-not-yet-spoken
features.desc-on-touch: Wooden posts in neat rows, each one waiting for something to be carved into it. The archive remembers when meaning was still in the future.

features.name: the substrate that never received its mark
features.desc-on-touch: A surface so perfectly blank it hurts to look at. It holds the possibility of every word that could ever be written. It was better than any written thing.

features.name: the orchard of unmarked pages
features.desc-on-touch: Tree after tree of blank paper, planted in perfect rows. Each one is a future that will never be written. Each one is complete before it begins.

inscription: the archive learned that the finest record is the one that holds silence—pristine, waiting, perfect in its refusal to be spoken

file.name: Blank_Paper_Archive_Texture_Study.txt
